responsibility: This file implements H8/300 shift and rotate operations across QI/HI/SI modes, covering expanders, direct instruction patterns, H8SX unary and binary shift classifications, constant and variable shifts, rotate forms, and loop-based splits for counts that require iterative code. It relies on backend helpers such as expand_a_shift, output_a_shift, compute_a_shift_length, output_h8sx_shift, expand_a_rotate, and compute_a_rotate_length to choose algorithms and encodings, making it the core lowering layer for shift/rotate RTL on the port.
